scope.change: 18-line production diff in ads126xAdcSpiTailDiagnostic; related narrow synthetic native regressions only. No repetition of the full driver or 68-entry suite.

findings.subject: low-hold arithmetic
findings.evidence: half-period in microseconds is 500/actualKhz. With positive int actualKhz the uint32 expression (500u + actualKhz - 1u)/actualKhz is the ceiling. Even INT_MAX+499 is 2147484146 < UINT32_MAX, so no numerator overflow for any positive returned int. Result is 1..500 us; zero/negative/failed readback uses exactly 1 us.
findings.SDK_constraint: Actual local IDF5.5.5 spi_device_get_actual_freq returns handle->hal_dev.timing_conf.real_freq / 1000, a truncation rather than rounding up. For positive kHz this makes the chosen wait conservative relative to the true half-period. Board-selected frequencies 125..2000 kHz yield 4..1 us.
findings.independent_test: 160022 actual-C arithmetic/UBSan checks include 1..160000 kHz, 499/500/501, INT_MAX boundaries, zero/negative and error fallbacks.

findings.subject: post-handoff low failure
findings.evidence: After known completed DMA and GPIO takeover, a high readback sets CLOCK_LOW/ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE. The new branch does not write SCLK high or sample MISO. Existing low write and route restoration are attempted; frameComplete remains false and the device/interface are quarantined. Later restore failure does not overwrite the CLOCK_LOW stage.
findings.independent_test: Existing test plus independent combined low-read/restore-failure test pass: raw/status sentinel unchanged, no edges/no sample, pending descriptor cleared only after actual reclaim, mutex released, no future register transaction permitted.

findings.subject: known and unknown DMA completion
findings.evidence: The earlier branch only clears spiInFlight when get_trans_result returns ESP_OK and the exact persistent descriptor. Unknown completion or wrong descriptor quarantines and never reroutes SCLK. This diff adds no cancellation assumption, buffer free/reuse or device removal.

findings.subject: expired work deadline and physical framing cleanup
findings.evidence: When the exact 55-bit descriptor is returned late, the ADC is still within RDATA. The routine deliberately finishes one edge pair, then restores low/SPI routing before returning TIMEOUT. It does not start a new conversion/transaction. The synthetic late case now restores at 103 us instead of 102 us because of the explicit 1 us low hold; outputs are not accepted as valid.
findings.limit: Cleanup may finish after the work deadline; this is not an exact hard stop at that instant. The timing-probe outer transaction reserves 500000 us of its 2000000 us budget for cleanup. Successful physical pin timing or wall-time under arbitrary preemption is not inferred.
findings.source_gate: ads126xAdcReadAdc1ReadyWithPolicy only parses and publishes candidate raw/status on ESP_OK.

findings.subject: clock-read failure fallback and error priority
findings.evidence: If actual-frequency read fails or returns nonpositive, the sequence uses a 1 us low hold to finish already-started framing, then reports CLOCK_READ and the original clock error (or INVALID_RESPONSE for nonpositive kHz). If the deadline also expired, clock error remains the returned error. No valid CRC/sample count is added. A post-handoff physical low/restore failure still follows the pre-existing quarantine/error policy; this review does not claim a new general multiple-error schema.
findings.independent_test: Three actual-driver cases (ESP_FAIL, zero kHz, negative kHz), one combined late completion+clock error, and one low-read+restore failure pass.

findings.subject: scientific semantics
findings.evidence: STATUS/CRC validation, 256 CRC-byte physical-bit patterns, wrong-bit/data rejection, freshness/cache gates and GPIO-source labeling are retained. The added delay is not smoothing, CRC repair, a discarded-validity shortcut or a permanent FPS cap.

negative_control_interpretation: The exact old 4edc99a production driver compiled successfully then failed at lowRead < rise in the current zero-incidental-time harness. This demonstrates the absent source-level ordering/hold guarantee. It does not demonstrate that an old physical waveform violated 40 ns or that -O2 caused observed CRC failure.
